application_conditions: Apply via app/website, complete identity verification, approval. Affiliate Program is aimed at "institutions, B2B partners, and professional marketers"; new affiliates start at the LV1 rate and "automatically upgrade to Exclusive after successfully inviting 100 card activations". Referral levels LV1 (0–9 referrals), LV2 (10–29), LV3 (30+); Exclusive for KOLs/Affiliates/Redot Angels who cooperate directly with RedotPay (blog 2025-03-28, confirmed by the Dec 2024 affiliate blog). Help centre (2026-07-26): users "with a large following can apply for the Partner Program on the Referral page for higher commission rates".
paid_action: Card Order Commission: percentage of the card fee when a referee orders a virtual or physical card, paid instantly (no commission if the referee used a discount code of 50 % or more). Payment Commission: percentage of the transaction amount on referees' card spend, settled every 30 days. Secondary (Tier-2) Commission: 10 % of the referee's own commission, valid 365 days from the invitee's registration. Tiered levels unlock higher rates.
validation_conditions: Transaction commissions settled every 30 days. Refunded card purchases: the related commission is deducted from the balance. Referral codes must be entered at registration (cannot be added later). Rates per level are shown only as an image on the blogs (unreadable to the fetcher).

commission.model_note: 'Up to 40% commission' headline (landing page, read 2026-10-28; landing page unreadable to the fetcher on 2026-11-17 — provenance). Card-order and payment commission percentages per level still only in images; no figure in any official text. 2026-11-17 re-read of the official blogs and help centre confirms the structure (card order / payment / 10 % secondary for 365 days / levels), not the rates.

revenue_share.duration_note: Tier-2 for 365 days; direct duration not stated

payout.holdbacks_note: 30-day settlement of payment commissions; refund → commission deducted; card orders with a ≥ 50 % discount code earn nothing.
